sara: audit-alert from iam-scanner: kms key used by vault-auto-unseal has an unexpected member: serviceAccount:partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. flagging sec + infra. looks like terraform module infra/partners/legacy-policy added it long ago. we need containment + rotation.

dan: ouch. can you paste the key resource path? i'll run a scoped check and start a blocker PR if needed.

sara: key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/vault/cryptoKeys/vault-auto-unseal. quick repro command: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/vault/cryptoKeys/vault-auto-unseal --format=json` (sanitized in audit doc).

omar: recommended containment: 1) remove partner principal from key IAM (blocker PR) 2) create new dedicated SA for vault auto-unseal with minimal scope 3) create a new key (vault-auto-unseal-rot2024) and rewrap all Vault wrapped blobs/backups 4) rotate any downstream long-lived creds referenced in those backups. i'll take 2-4. dan can you open PR for 1?

dan: will do. i want to avoid breaking auto-unseal during removal. plan: remove partner principal from IAM but keep current SA bindings intact. do a staged change in terraform -> plan -> apply during maintenance window. opening PR now: infra#1310.

maria: audit/ops: enable KMS admin logs to splunk and extend retention to 180d for this key immediately. also create an alert for any future grant to roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. i'll handle logging.

alice: oncall: suggest a canary run on a recent snapshot in staging first. schedule prod window 03:00-04:00 UTC tonight. rollback will be import old key version + restore backup objects. i'll be oncall for the window.

omar: rewrap notes (short):
- create key ring/key `vault-auto-unseal-rot2024` in same location
- update Vault auto-unseal config (vault.hcl) to point to new key path (test on standby)
- for each backup blob: decrypt with old key then encrypt with new key or use `gcloud kms encrypt` with new key and overwrite ciphertext prefix
- rotate Vault unseal tokens and revoke any long-lived root tokens used for backup operations
- run decrypt checks on vault-standby and the app read path

sara: scope: i scanned backups + parameter store; found 9 vault-backup objects and 4 external webhook secrets that embed the old ciphertext prefix. omar please produce a script to bulk re-encrypt and a map of owners so we can schedule phasing.

omar: script ready, pushed to the audit doc (redwood.internal/secret-audit/rot2024). it handles GCS objects + local backup tarballs, and prints a dry-run list. testing against staging snapshot now. vault-bot: please queue the decrypt-ci job for staging.

vault-bot: queued job #4991 -> https://ci.internal/jobs/4991. will post status.

dan: PR infra#1310 created removing partner principal and adding a terraform lock update. tagging infra leads for urgent review. ETA for merge if approved: 2h.

maria: KMS admin logs enabled and routed to splunk. retention bumped; alert rule created for future grants. attaching audit id in doc.

alice: maintenance timeline: 02:30 UTC staging canary (run omar's script + CI decrypt). if green, begin prod rewrap at 03:05 UTC. keep window 1h. rollback steps: re-import old key into KMS and restore ciphertext from backups. i'll post precise commands in the runbook.

sara: final owners/ETAs: dan (policy PR) 2h, omar (new key + rewrap script + staging run) 6h to stage, mari(a) (audit & alerts) 1h, alice (oncall + window) available tonight. i'll coordinate partner notification after removal.

vault-bot: staging job #4991 completed: PASS. details: decrypt test OK on vault-standby.

omar: starting prod rewrap sequence in 10 min. will update doc with new key name and service account email when created.

sara: thanks team. when prod rewrap and token rotations are complete i'll close the thread. keep chatter here minimal and record steps in the shared runbook. :lock:
